title: WebDancer: Towards Autonomous Information Seeking Agency
authors_zh: Jialong Wu, Baixuan Li, Runnan Fang, Wenbiao Yin, Liwen Zhang, Zhenglin Wang, Zhengwei Tao, Ding-Chu Zhang, Zekun Xi, Robert Tang, Yong Jiang, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang, Jingren Zhou
paper_type_zh: Web Agent 轨迹构造与 Agent RL 配方
best_for_zh: 研究 web-agent 数据合成、轨迹 SFT、judge-based agent RL 与 live-web 复现审计的读者
one_line: WebDancer turns 100,000 synthetic web QA pairs into filtered ReAct SFT trajectories and LLM-judged on-policy agent rollouts, but publicly releases only 200 QA and 200 trajectory examples rather than the complete corpus.
WebDancer 将 10 万条合成 web QA 转化为过滤后的 ReAct SFT 轨迹和由 LLM judge 评分的 on-policy rollout，但仅公开 200 条 QA 与 200 条冷启动轨迹样例。
why: It exposes how task synthesis, trajectory teachers, observation masking, rejection filters, dynamic rollout selection, and judge-based terminal rewards jointly define web-agent post-training data, while showing why live-web drift and sample-only releases block record-level replay and audit.
inclusion_reason: WebDancer makes the full data-to-policy boundary unusually concrete for a live-web agent: synthetic short-answer tasks become filtered ReAct trajectories for SFT, while unused QA pairs seed on-policy episodes scored by format validity and an LLM answer judge. It belongs in the environment-and-agent-trajectory category, but its sample-only release and non-replayable web substrate prevent treating the reported corpus as a complete reusable trajectory dataset.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary sources are the NeurIPS 2025 proceedings record and 29-page paper, arXiv:2505.22648, and the Alibaba-NLP DeepResearch/WebAgent repository. The formal proceedings list fourteen authors and use “Robert Tang”; the PDF prints “Xiangru Tang,” while the arXiv and repository citation use a shorter author list. This Card follows the venue metadata and preserves the discrepancy as an audit item.

WebDancer addresses a data and training gap in deep information seeking. Many existing QA tasks can be solved in two or three searches, while a useful autonomous search agent must decompose a question, alternate reasoning with tool calls, absorb changing web observations, and decide when enough evidence supports a concise answer. The work therefore treats the web environment and the full behavior trace—not only the final answer—as post-training inputs.

The construction begins with 60,000 CRAWLQA and 40,000 E2HQA question-answer pairs. These tasks seed GPT-4o or QwQ-Plus ReAct trajectories consisting of Thought, structured search/visit Action, Observation, and final Answer. Selected trajectories provide cold-start SFT supervision; QA pairs not used by SFT can seed on-policy DAPO episodes with terminal format and answer rewards. This makes the paper directly relevant to environment_agent_trajectory_data.

The scope is narrower than a general browser agent: the reported environment exposes search and visit, the main experiments emphasize short-answer information seeking, and live pages are not frozen for replay. The repository releases a WebDancer-32B checkpoint, demo/inference code, 200 QA examples, and 200 cold-start trajectory examples, not the complete 100,000 QA pool, 14,228 reported SFT trajectories, or RL rollout logs. The Card therefore remains L3 and card: null pending human review of the release and replay boundary. (Paper §§1–3; Appendix D; official repository datasets and issue #35.)

本卡的一手来源是 NeurIPS 2025 正式 proceedings 条目及 29 页论文、arXiv:2505.22648，以及 Alibaba-NLP 的 DeepResearch/WebAgent 仓库。正式 proceedings 列出 14 位作者并使用“Robert Tang”；PDF 首页写作“Xiangru Tang”，arXiv 与仓库引用又采用更短的作者列表。本卡以正式 venue metadata 为准，并把这一差异保留为审计事项。

WebDancer 处理的是 deep information seeking 中的数据与训练缺口。许多既有 QA 任务只需两三次检索即可完成，而可用的自主搜索 agent 必须分解问题、交替进行推理和工具调用、吸收不断变化的网页 observation，并判断何时已有足够证据给出简短答案。因此，该工作把 web 环境和完整行为轨迹，而不只是最终答案，视为 post-training 输入。

构造从 60,000 条 CRAWLQA 与 40,000 条 E2HQA 问答开始。这些任务用于生成由 GPT-4o 或 QwQ-Plus 驱动的 ReAct 轨迹，轨迹包含 Thought、结构化 search/visit Action、Observation 与最终 Answer。筛选后的轨迹提供冷启动 SFT 监督；未进入 SFT 的 QA 可用于 on-policy DAPO episode，并接收终局格式奖励和答案奖励。因此，该论文直接属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data。

其范围比通用 browser agent 更窄：论文环境只提供 search 与 visit，主要实验聚焦短答案信息检索，live web 页面也没有冻结以供重放。仓库公开了 WebDancer-32B checkpoint、demo/inference 代码、200 条 QA 样例和 200 条冷启动轨迹样例，但没有公开完整 100,000 条 QA、论文报告的 14,228 条 SFT 轨迹或 RL rollout 日志。因此，本卡保持 L3 与 card: null，等待人工复核发布和 replay 边界。（论文 §§1–3、Appendix D；官方仓库 datasets 与 issue #35。）

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
WebDancer's central contribution is an end-to-end data-to-policy pipeline: synthesize difficult short-answer web tasks, sample and filter complete ReAct demonstrations, use them for cold-start SFT, then reuse remaining QA pairs for on-policy agent RL.

CRAWLQA recursively visits pages below knowledgeable root sites and asks GPT-4o to create typed questions such as COUNT, MULTI-HOP, and INTERSECTION. E2HQA starts from a SimpleQA-style question with a concise entity answer, searches for information about an entity in the question, and rewrites that entity into a new subproblem while preserving the answer. The trajectory stage then uses GPT-4o for Short-CoT behavior and QwQ-Plus for Long-CoT behavior, with up to five rejection-sampling attempts per QA.

The training object is a full episode history of Thought, Action, and Observation. Search receives query and filter_year and returns ten result titles/snippets; visit receives goal and url_link and returns evidence plus a Qwen-2.5-72B summary. SFT masks observation tokens, so supervision attaches to model-generated thoughts, actions, and answers while the external feedback remains context.

The RL feedback contract is mixed rather than purely environmental. A binary format checker can observe whether the whole output and JSON tool calls are valid. A Qwen-72B-Instruct judge supplies binary answer correctness against the reference. Their weighted terminal reward is 0.1 score_format + 0.9 score_answer; it cannot identify the first bad reasoning step, verify citation faithfulness, or guarantee that a successful answer followed a sound search path.

Compared with prompting-only agents, Search-o1, WebThinker, R1-Searcher, SimpleDeepSearcher, and concurrent end-to-end agent RL, WebDancer's distinguishing object is the connected four-stage pipeline and its explicit Short-CoT/Long-CoT trajectory construction. It is not a new search engine, browser environment, foundation model, ReAct protocol, DAPO optimizer, or general long-form research benchmark. (Paper §§2–3 and Appendix E.)

WebDancer 的核心贡献是一条端到端 data-to-policy 管线：先合成困难的短答案 web 任务，再采样并筛选完整 ReAct demonstration，用其完成冷启动 SFT，随后把剩余 QA 重新用于 on-policy agent RL。

CRAWLQA 从知识性 root site 出发递归访问子页面，并让 GPT-4o 生成 COUNT、MULTI-HOP、INTERSECTION 等指定类型的问题。E2HQA 从带简短实体答案的 SimpleQA-style 问题开始，检索问题中某个实体的相关信息，再把该实体重写成新的子问题，同时保持答案不变。轨迹阶段使用 GPT-4o 生成 Short-CoT 行为，使用 QwQ-Plus 生成 Long-CoT 行为，每条 QA 最多进行 5 次 rejection sampling。

训练对象是一段由 Thought、Action 与 Observation 构成的完整 episode history。search 接收 query 与 filter_year，返回 10 条结果的标题和 snippet；visit 接收 goal 与 url_link，返回 evidence 以及 Qwen-2.5-72B 生成的摘要。SFT 会屏蔽 observation token 的 loss，因此监督附着在模型生成的 thought、action 与 answer 上，外部反馈只作为上下文。

RL 反馈契约是 mixed，而不是纯 environmental。二元格式检查器能够观察完整输出与 JSON 工具调用是否有效；Qwen-72B-Instruct judge 根据参考答案给出二元答案正确性。终局奖励为 0.1 score_format + 0.9 score_answer；它无法定位第一处错误推理步骤，也不能验证引用忠实性或保证成功答案来自可靠搜索路径。

与 prompting-only agent、Search-o1、WebThinker、R1-Searcher、SimpleDeepSearcher 及同期端到端 agent RL 相比，WebDancer 的差异化对象是相互连接的四阶段管线，以及显式的 Short-CoT/Long-CoT 轨迹构造。它并未提出新的搜索引擎、browser 环境、foundation model、ReAct 协议、DAPO optimizer 或通用长文研究 benchmark。（论文 §§2–3 与 Appendix E。）

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are 60,000 CRAWLQA pairs, 40,000 E2HQA pairs, and a separate open-only mixture drawn from MuSiQue, Bamboogle, PopQA, 2Wiki, and HotpotQA after a simple RAG filter removes easy questions. CRAWLQA uses GPT-4o over recursively crawled web content. E2HQA repeatedly searches around an entity and rewrites the original question so the new subproblem must be solved before the unchanged concise answer can be recovered.

Trajectory generation runs in Qwen-Agents ReAct with search and visit. GPT-4o produces Short-CoT trajectories. QwQ-Plus produces Long-CoT thoughts and actions from historical actions and observations; prior thoughts are withheld from its next call, but current reasoning_content is retained as supervision. Each QA is sampled at most five times. The paper's multi-stage funnel discards malformed ReAct output, uses GPT-4o to keep correct answers, then applies repetition/hallucination rules and prompted criteria for information non-redundancy, goal alignment, logical reasoning, and accuracy. Appendix D additionally limits a repeated 10-gram to four occurrences. The prose about filtering trajectories “with more than two actions” conflicts with Table 4 mean action counts above two, so the exact threshold direction is not reconstructable.

The retained records are converted to multi-turn ChatML. Thought uses the think tag, JSON actions the tool_call tag, observations the tool_response tag, and the final response the answer tag. Table 4 reports 7,678 Short-CoT trajectories with mean action count 4.56 and mean thought length 510.03 tokens, plus 6,550 Long-CoT trajectories with mean action count 2.31 and mean thought length 1,599.39 tokens. SFT trains Qwen2.5-7B/32B on Short-CoT and QwQ-32B on Long-CoT while masking observation-token loss.

For RL, QA pairs not used by SFT seed live-web rollouts. DAPO samples 16 executions per question, optimizes only model-generated tokens, and dynamically excludes groups that are all correct or all wrong. Format validity is binary; answer correctness is a binary Qwen-72B-Instruct judgment; reward is 0.1 score_format + 0.9 score_answer. Non-RL inference uses temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.95; RL rollouts use temperature 1.0 and top-p 1.0. The paper reports 32 nodes with eight H20 96GB GPUs per node and notes that only a small subset, for example 5,000 pairs, can be used in RL because of cost and stability.

Outputs are SFT policies and DAPO-refined web agents evaluated on GAIA and WebWalkerQA, with later analysis on BrowseComp. Public reproduction can inspect 200 QA samples, 200 cold-start trajectory samples, demo/inference code, and WebDancer-32B. It cannot reconstruct the complete training split, rejected examples, judge decisions, on-policy rewards, modified verl configuration, or historical web observations. Reproduction must therefore pin repository/model revisions, tool providers, search/page state, prompts, judge snapshot, dependencies, seeds, and episode budgets. (Paper §§2–4; Appendices A, D, E; official repository.)

输入包括 60,000 条 CRAWLQA、40,000 条 E2HQA，以及一个独立的 open-only mixture；后者从 MuSiQue、Bamboogle、PopQA、2Wiki 与 HotpotQA 中取题，并用简单 RAG filter 删除容易问题。CRAWLQA 让 GPT-4o 基于递归抓取的网页内容生成问答。E2HQA 围绕实体反复搜索并重写原问题，使模型必须先解决新增子问题，才能恢复保持不变的简短答案。

轨迹生成运行在带 search 与 visit 的 Qwen-Agents ReAct 中。GPT-4o 生成 Short-CoT 轨迹；QwQ-Plus 根据历史 action 与 observation 生成 Long-CoT thought/action，其下一次调用不接收先前 thought，但当前 reasoning_content 会保留为监督。每条 QA 最多采样 5 次。论文的多阶段漏斗先丢弃格式错误的 ReAct 输出，再由 GPT-4o 保留正确答案，最后应用重复/幻觉规则及信息非冗余、目标对齐、逻辑推理与准确性 prompt criteria。Appendix D 还把同一 10-gram 的重复限制为最多 4 次。正文声称过滤“超过两个 action”的轨迹，但 Table 4 的平均 action count 高于 2，两者冲突，因此无法重建该阈值的准确方向。

保留记录被转换为 multi-turn ChatML：Thought 使用 think 标签，JSON action 使用 tool_call 标签，observation 使用 tool_response 标签，最终回答使用 answer 标签。Table 4 报告 7,678 条 Short-CoT 轨迹，平均 action count 为 4.56、平均 thought length 为 510.03 tokens；另有 6,550 条 Long-CoT 轨迹，平均 action count 为 2.31、平均 thought length 为 1,599.39 tokens。SFT 使用 Short-CoT 训练 Qwen2.5-7B/32B，使用 Long-CoT 训练 QwQ-32B，并屏蔽 observation token 的 loss。

RL 阶段由未用于 SFT 的 QA 发起 live-web rollout。DAPO 每题采样 16 条 execution，只优化模型生成 token，并动态排除全对或全错的 group。格式有效性与 Qwen-72B-Instruct 判定的答案正确性均为二元信号；奖励为 0.1 score_format + 0.9 score_answer。非 RL inference 使用 temperature 0.6、top-p 0.95；RL rollout 使用 temperature 1.0、top-p 1.0。论文报告使用 32 个 node、每个 node 配置 8 张 H20 96GB GPU，并指出受成本和稳定性限制，RL 只能利用较小子集，例如 5,000 条 QA。

输出是 SFT policy 与经 DAPO 优化的 web agent，并在 GAIA、WebWalkerQA 及后续 BrowseComp 分析中评测。公开材料允许检查 200 条 QA 样例、200 条冷启动轨迹样例、demo/inference 代码和 WebDancer-32B，但不能重建完整训练 split、拒绝样本、judge 决策、on-policy reward、修改版 verl 配置或历史网页 observation。复现时必须固定仓库/模型 revision、工具服务、搜索与页面状态、prompt、judge snapshot、依赖、seed 和 episode budget。（论文 §§2–4；Appendices A、D、E；官方仓库。）

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under the paper's LLM-as-judge Pass@1 evaluation on 103 text-only GAIA validation questions and 680 WebWalkerQA test questions, Table 1 reports consistent gains over the corresponding vanilla ReAct policies. Qwen2.5-7B WebDancer scores 31.0 versus 18.4 on GAIA average and 36.0 versus 24.2 on WebWalkerQA average. Qwen2.5-32B scores 40.7 versus 31.0 and 38.4 versus 31.9. QwQ-32B scores 51.5 versus 37.8 and 47.9 versus 24.1. These are author-reported live-agent results, not independent reproductions.

The paper's best-performing model reaches Pass@3 of 64.1% on GAIA and 62.0% on WebWalkerQA. Figure 4 reports that RL improves Pass@1, Pass@3, and Consistency@3 more clearly for the non-reasoning Qwen models; for QwQ, the gains are smaller and the authors associate the weaker signal with sparse rewards on very long trajectories. A cold-start ablation that begins RL without SFT reaches only 5% Pass@3 on GAIA, supporting the paper's claim that trajectory SFT is important for learning the interaction format before on-policy optimization.

Table 3 isolates a transfer tradeoff. For QwQ-32B, Long-CoT SFT reaches 58.25 Pass@3 and 39.66 Consistency@3 versus 44.66 and 28.33 for Short-CoT, but its invalid rate rises from 0.97% to 13.27%. Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-32B also show higher invalid rates under Long-CoT—21.36% and 13.59%, respectively—than under Short-CoT—0.65% and 4.20%. This supports a data-format conclusion, not a general claim that longer reasoning is always better.

Figure 3 compares open-only, CRAWLQA-only, E2HQA-only, their union, and the final filtered subset; the final 6,550 Long-CoT set outperforms larger unfiltered alternatives under the reported low-data setting. Figure 5c finds little sensitivity to decoding temperatures 0.5–0.7 and attributes more variation to live-web non-stationarity. Both interpretations depend on the unreleased complete data and historical environment, so they remain author claims. (Paper Table 1, Tables 2–3, Figures 3–5, Appendix E.)

在 103 条 text-only GAIA validation 问题和 680 条 WebWalkerQA test 问题上，论文使用 LLM-as-judge Pass@1 评测；Table 1 报告 WebDancer 相对同 backbone vanilla ReAct 的一致提升。Qwen2.5-7B WebDancer 的 GAIA average 为 31.0，对照为 18.4；WebWalkerQA average 为 36.0，对照为 24.2。Qwen2.5-32B 对应结果分别为 40.7 对 31.0、38.4 对 31.9。QwQ-32B 分别为 51.5 对 37.8、47.9 对 24.1。这些是作者报告的 live-agent 结果，尚未独立复现。

论文最佳模型在 GAIA 与 WebWalkerQA 上的 Pass@3 分别为 64.1% 与 62.0%。Figure 4 显示，RL 对非 reasoning Qwen 模型的 Pass@1、Pass@3 和 Consistency@3 改善更明显；QwQ 的增益较小，作者将较弱信号与超长轨迹产生的 sparse reward 联系起来。一个不经过 SFT、直接开始 RL 的冷启动消融在 GAIA 上只有 5% Pass@3，支持“先用轨迹 SFT 学会交互格式，再进行 on-policy 优化”的主张。

Table 3 展示了迁移权衡。QwQ-32B 使用 Long-CoT SFT 时取得 58.25 Pass@3 与 39.66 Consistency@3，Short-CoT 对应为 44.66 与 28.33；但 invalid rate 从 0.97% 上升到 13.27%。Qwen2.5-7B 与 Qwen2.5-32B 在 Long-CoT 下的 invalid rate 也分别达到 21.36% 与 13.59%，高于 Short-CoT 的 0.65% 与 4.20%。这支持的是数据格式层面的结论，不能推成“推理越长越好”。

Figure 3 比较 open-only、CRAWLQA-only、E2HQA-only、三者全集以及最终过滤子集；在论文报告的 low-data 设置下，最终 6,550 条 Long-CoT 数据优于更大的未过滤方案。Figure 5c 显示结果对 0.5–0.7 decoding temperature 不太敏感，并把更多波动归因于 live-web 非平稳性。由于完整数据与历史环境没有公开，这两项解释仍属于作者主张。（论文 Table 1、Tables 2–3、Figures 3–5、Appendix E。）

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior work typically occupies one of three positions: prompt a capable model to search without training; perform SFT on selected web trajectories; or apply outcome-based RL to search behavior. WebDancer does not invent those components. Its concrete change is to connect task synthesis, two teacher styles, trajectory rejection sampling, observation-masked SFT, live-web rollouts, model-based terminal reward, and DAPO dynamic sampling in one reported agent pipeline.

The new data object is not merely a QA pair. A constructed question has an answer-preserving lineage, can yield several attempted ReAct trajectories, passes validity/correctness/quality filters, enters either SFT or RL, and during RL becomes a 16-execution group whose reward variance determines whether the prompt contributes an update. This makes selection state and environment feedback part of the effective training corpus.

The Short-CoT/Long-CoT split is also a useful direction signal. GPT-4o produces compact ReAct demonstrations, while QwQ-Plus supplies longer reasoning without receiving its previous thoughts on the next call. Table 3 shows that this teacher choice changes both success and invalid-output rates, exposing cross-model trace transfer as a data-design variable rather than a generic distillation benefit.

What is not new includes ReAct, GPT-4o/QwQ teachers, Qwen backbones, Qwen-Agents, web search and page summarization, SFT, DAPO, verl, LLM-as-judge, and the GAIA/WebWalkerQA benchmarks. The “end-to-end” claim describes their integration and training order; it does not establish a new deterministic environment or fully open release.

Before reuse, verify the full prompt lineage, correct interpretation of the action-count filter, exact SFT/RL split, judge prompt and snapshot, failed-sample retention, web-service versions, benchmark overlap, and dataset-specific rights. Without those checks, the work is most reliable as a construction and audit reference plus a small released-sample inspection point. (Paper §§1–3, Table 3, Appendices D–E.)

既有工作通常处于三类位置之一：不训练、直接 prompting 强模型进行搜索；在筛选后的 web 轨迹上做 SFT；或用 outcome-based RL 优化搜索行为。WebDancer 并未发明这些组件。它的具体变化是把任务合成、两种 teacher 风格、轨迹 rejection sampling、屏蔽 observation 的 SFT、live-web rollout、模型式终局奖励和 DAPO dynamic sampling 串成一条完整的 agent 管线。

新的数据对象不只是 QA pair。一个构造问题具有保持答案不变的 lineage，可产生多条候选 ReAct 轨迹，通过有效性/正确性/质量筛选后进入 SFT 或 RL；在 RL 中，它又变成包含 16 条 execution 的 group，其 reward variance 决定该 prompt 是否参与更新。因此，selection state 与环境反馈本身成为有效训练语料的一部分。

Short-CoT/Long-CoT 划分也是有价值的方向信号。GPT-4o 生成紧凑 ReAct demonstration；QwQ-Plus 提供更长推理，但下一次调用不会接收其先前 thought。Table 3 表明 teacher 选择同时改变成功率与 invalid-output rate，说明跨模型 trace transfer 是数据设计变量，而不是普遍成立的 distillation 增益。

并非新贡献的部分包括 ReAct、GPT-4o/QwQ teacher、Qwen backbone、Qwen-Agents、web search 与页面摘要、SFT、DAPO、verl、LLM-as-judge，以及 GAIA/WebWalkerQA benchmark。“端到端”描述的是这些组件的集成与训练顺序，并不意味着论文提供了新的确定性环境或完整开放发布。

复用前应核验完整 prompt lineage、action-count filter 的准确含义、精确 SFT/RL split、judge prompt 与 snapshot、失败样本保留、web 服务版本、benchmark overlap 和 dataset-specific rights。在这些问题解决前，该工作最可靠的用途是构造/审计参考，以及对小规模公开样例的检查入口。（论文 §§1–3、Table 3、Appendices D–E。）

title: Limitations
局限
html:
WebDancer is a useful recipe paper, but its training evidence and public release do not support full reconstruction.

  • Restricted environment and task form. The agent exposes only search and visit and is optimized for short-answer information seeking. Appendix A explicitly leaves richer tools and broader long-form synthesis to future work.
  • Cost-limited RL scale. Appendix A describes reinforcement learning on roughly 5,000 query–response pairs because multi-turn web rollouts are expensive and training can become unstable. The paper also reports tool hallucination and over-action, motivating future hybrid thinking rather than establishing that the current policy is robust to those failures.
  • Partial public data. The repository releases qa_sample.jsonl and traj_sample.jsonl with 200 records each. Maintainer issue #35 says these are samples and that release of the full QA and trajectory data is still under consideration. No complete supervised corpus, rollout log, reward trace, rejected trajectory set, exact split manifest, or modified verl training code is public.
  • Ambiguous filtering description. Section 3.2 says trajectories “with more than two actions” are filtered out, while Table 4 reports 4.56 mean actions for the 7,678 Short-CoT trajectories. The evidence therefore does not resolve the intended inequality or exact filter implementation.
  • Reproducibility and evaluation risks. Search and page contents come from the live web, but no immutable web snapshot or retrieval cache is released. The reward's answer component is a binary judgment from Qwen-72B-Instruct, and the paper does not report a calibration study for this judge. Main evaluation uses 103 text-only GAIA validation questions and 680 WebWalkerQA test questions, so the reported results should not be treated as a general web-agent guarantee.
  • Metadata and governance gaps. The formal proceedings list 14 authors and use “Robert Tang,” whereas the PDF author block uses “Xiangru Tang” and the arXiv/repository metadata expose a shorter list. The WebAgent directory carries an MIT code license, but dataset-specific usage terms, privacy screening, provenance manifests, decontamination evidence, and per-example source lineage are not disclosed.

These omissions are audit findings, not evidence that the unreleased artifacts or controls do not exist.

WebDancer 是一篇有价值的流程论文，但其训练证据和公开发布范围尚不足以支持完整复现。

  • 环境与任务形态受限。 智能体只暴露 search 和 visit 两个工具，并针对短答案信息检索优化。附录 A 明确把更丰富的工具和更广泛的长文本综合留作未来工作。
  • RL 规模受成本约束。 附录 A 说明，强化学习只使用约 5,000 个查询—响应对，因为多轮网页 rollout 成本高且训练可能不稳定。论文还报告工具幻觉和过度行动，并据此提出未来采用混合思考；这并不能证明当前策略已能稳健处理这些失败模式。
  • 公开数据不完整。 仓库仅发布各含 200 条记录的 qa_sample.jsonl 与 traj_sample.jsonl。维护者在 issue #35 中说明这些只是样例，完整 QA 与轨迹数据是否发布仍在考虑。完整监督语料、rollout 日志、奖励轨迹、被拒绝轨迹集、精确划分清单以及修改后的 verl 训练代码均未公开。
  • 过滤描述存在歧义。 第 3.2 节称过滤掉“动作数多于两个”的轨迹，但表 4 又报告 7,678 条 Short-CoT 轨迹的平均动作数为 4.56。现有证据无法确定预期的不等式方向或精确过滤实现。
  • 复现与评测风险。 搜索结果和网页内容来自实时网络，但项目未发布不可变网页快照或检索缓存。奖励中的答案项由 Qwen-72B-Instruct 给出二元判断，论文未报告该裁判模型的校准研究。主要评测只覆盖 103 道纯文本 GAIA 验证题和 680 道 WebWalkerQA 测试题，因此不宜把结果外推为通用网页智能体保证。
  • 元数据与治理缺口。 正式会议页面列出 14 位作者并使用“Robert Tang”，PDF 作者栏使用“Xiangru Tang”，而 arXiv 与仓库元数据的作者列表更短。WebAgent 目录采用 MIT 代码许可证，但数据集专属使用条款、隐私筛查、来源清单、去污染证据和逐样本来源链路均未披露。

上述内容是审计发现，并不表示未公开的工件或控制措施一定不存在。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
WebDancer is most useful as an auditable blueprint for building an information-seeking agent, and only secondarily as a small public-data resource.

For recipe design, it cleanly separates four layers: synthesizing difficult questions, sampling tool-using trajectories, selecting successful trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, and then applying outcome-reward reinforcement learning. Implementers can reuse that separation while recording the query generator, teacher model, tool implementation, sampled candidates, filtering decisions, reward outputs, and model checkpoint for every stage.

For schema inspection, the two 200-record sample files show concrete question/answer and ChatML-style trajectory objects, including tool calls, observations, and assistant reasoning. They are suitable for parser tests, UI demonstrations, format conversion, and small-scale audit exercises. They are not evidence of a license-cleared, complete training release and should not be represented as the 60,000-question CRAWLQA pool, the 40,000-question E2HQA pool, or the 14,228 selected SFT trajectories.

For experimental baselines, the paper provides useful design choices: sample (N=5) candidate trajectories during rejection sampling; mask observation tokens from the SFT loss; sample 16 rollouts per RL question; and combine a 0.1 binary format reward with a 0.9 binary Qwen-72B-Instruct answer reward. A faithful adaptation should retain raw judge outputs and all-zero/all-one groups, report judge calibration, and test reward sensitivity rather than treating the reward as ground truth.

The strongest justified reuse class is therefore reading/audit plus sample and schema inspection. Full training reconstruction remains blocked until the project releases the complete corpora, exact train/split/decontamination manifests, failed and rejected trajectories, RL rollout and reward logs, modified training code, environment versions, and a stable web-content snapshot or cache.

WebDancer 最适合被复用为可审计的信息检索智能体构建蓝图，其次才是一个小规模公开数据资源。

在流程设计上，它清晰拆分出四层：合成高难度问题、采样工具调用轨迹、筛选成功轨迹进行监督微调，以及随后采用结果奖励进行强化学习。复现者可以沿用这一分层，同时为每一阶段记录问题生成器、教师模型、工具实现、候选样本、过滤决策、奖励输出和模型检查点。

在模式检查上，两个各含 200 条记录的样例文件展示了具体的问答对象和 ChatML 风格轨迹对象，其中包含工具调用、观察结果与助手推理。这些样例适合解析器测试、界面演示、格式转换和小规模审计练习，但不能被表述为经过完整许可审查的训练集，也不能冒充包含 60,000 个问题的 CRAWLQA 池、包含 40,000 个问题的 E2HQA 池或 14,228 条入选 SFT 轨迹。

在实验基线上，论文给出了若干可复用设计：拒绝采样时为每题采样 (N=5) 条候选轨迹；在 SFT 损失中屏蔽 observation token；每个 RL 问题采样 16 个 rollout；把权重为 0.1 的二元格式奖励与权重为 0.9 的 Qwen-72B-Instruct 二元答案奖励组合起来。忠实改造时应保留原始裁判输出以及全零/全一组，报告裁判校准，并测试奖励敏感性，而不是把奖励直接视为事实标签。

因此，证据充分支持的最高复用等级是阅读/审计，以及样例和模式检查。在项目公开完整语料、精确训练/划分/去污染清单、失败与被拒绝轨迹、RL rollout 与奖励日志、修改后的训练代码、环境版本，以及稳定网页快照或缓存之前，完整训练复现仍不可行。

title: Reading notes

html:
• The pipeline has four evidence-distinct stages: synthesize 60,000 CRAWLQA and 40,000 E2HQA questions; sample trajectories; retain 7,678 Short-CoT plus 6,550 Long-CoT trajectories for SFT; and run outcome-reward RL.
  • The released trajectory sample preserves ChatML-like messages, tool calls, and observations. During SFT, observation tokens are masked, so the supervised target is the agent's reasoning/action behavior rather than copied web content.
  • Rejection sampling uses \(N=5\) candidates. RL samples 16 rollouts per question and uses \(0.1R_{format}+0.9R_{answer}\), where both components are binary and the answer is judged by Qwen-72B-Instruct.
  • Table 4 reports Short-CoT versus Long-CoT averages of 4.56 versus 2.31 actions and 510.03 versus 1,599.39 thought tokens. Table 3 shows that Long-CoT raises QwQ-32B Pass@3 from 44.66 to 58.25 but also raises invalid responses from 0.97% to 13.27%.
  • Public release is sample-only: 200 QA records and 200 trajectory records. Full data, failed/rejected trajectories, RL traces, exact split/decontamination metadata, and stable web snapshots are unavailable; the formal proceedings' 14-author list also differs from the PDF and shorter arXiv/repository metadata.

• 整条流水线包含四个证据边界清晰的阶段：合成含 60,000 个问题的 CRAWLQA 和含 40,000 个问题的 E2HQA；采样轨迹；保留 7,678 条 Short-CoT 与 6,550 条 Long-CoT 轨迹用于 SFT；最后执行结果奖励 RL。
  • 公开的轨迹样例保留了类似 ChatML 的消息、工具调用和观察结果。SFT 时屏蔽 observation token，因此监督目标是智能体的推理/行动行为，而不是复制网页内容。
  • 拒绝采样使用 \(N=5\) 个候选；RL 为每个问题采样 16 个 rollout，并使用 \(0.1R_{format}+0.9R_{answer}\)。两个分量均为二元奖励，答案由 Qwen-72B-Instruct 判断。
  • 表 4 显示 Short-CoT 与 Long-CoT 的平均动作数分别为 4.56 和 2.31，平均思考 token 数分别为 510.03 和 1,599.39。表 3 显示，Long-CoT 将 QwQ-32B 的 Pass@3 从 44.66 提高到 58.25，但无效响应比例也从 0.97% 增至 13.27%。

value.html: ReAct implemented on Qwen-Agents with search and visit; the released demo uses SGLang plus Serper search, Jina page access, and DashScope. Paper-bound service versions, index state, API responses, and dependency commits are not pinned.

value_zh.html: 在 Qwen-Agents 上实现的 ReAct，带 search 与 visit；已发布演示使用 SGLang 加 Serper 搜索、Jina 页面访问与 DashScope。论文绑定的服务版本、索引状态、API 响应与依赖 commit 未钉扎。

value.html: Binary correctness is required for retained SFT trajectories; prompted quality criteria must also pass. Numeric thresholds for the prompted quality checks are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 保留的 SFT 轨迹要求二元正确性；提示的质量标准也必须通过。提示质量检查的数值阈值未披露。

value.html: Use up to five trajectory samples per QA; discard invalid ReAct records; retain GPT-4o-judged correct answers; apply repetition/hallucination rules and prompted quality criteria; constrain repeated 10-grams to at most four occurrences. During DAPO, exclude all-correct and all-wrong 16-rollout groups. The paper's prose about filtering trajectories with more than two actions conflicts with Table 4 mean action counts above two, so that threshold direction is unknown.

value_zh.html: 每个 QA 最多使用五条轨迹样本；丢弃无效 ReAct 记录；保留 GPT-4o 判定正确的答案；应用重复/幻觉规则与提示的质量标准；将重复 10-grams 约束为最多出现四次。DAPO 期间排除全对与全错的 16-rollout 组。论文关于过滤超过两个动作的轨迹的行文与表 4 中高于二的平均动作计数冲突，因此该阈值方向未知。

value.html: All experiments use 32 nodes with eight NVIDIA H20 96GB GPUs per node. The paper discloses no maximum episode steps, token cap, search-call budget, random seeds, wall-clock cost, or exact number of RL training QA pairs.

value_zh.html: 所有实验使用 32 个节点，每节点八块 NVIDIA H20 96GB GPU。论文未披露最大 episode 步数、token 上限、搜索调用预算、随机种子、墙钟成本或 RL 训练 QA 对的确切数量。

value.html: Cold-start SFT uses multi-turn ChatML and masks external observation tokens. Agent RL uses DAPO implemented on a modified verl stack, optimizing only model-generated tokens while tool responses remain in the conditioning context.

value_zh.html: 冷启动 SFT 使用多轮 ChatML 并掩蔽外部 observation tokens。智能体 RL 使用在修改后 verl 栈上实现的 DAPO，仅优化模型生成的 tokens，同时工具响应保留在条件化上下文中。

items: GPT-4o selection and Qwen-72B-Instruct reward can produce false positives or false negatives; no calibration set, inter-judge agreement, frozen outputs, or adversarial judge audit is released.
The 0.9 answer-reward weight makes a judge shortcut dominate the binary format signal and cannot identify which search or reasoning step failed.
Dynamic sampling removes all-correct and all-wrong groups from gradient updates, changing the effective prompt distribution without a released per-prompt exclusion ledger.
Live search and summarizer drift can change observations and therefore both trajectories and judge outcomes even when the same question is replayed.
Format validity checks syntax and tool-call JSON, not factual grounding, source quality, citation faithfulness, or absence of unnecessary actions.
GPT-4o 选择与 Qwen-72B-Instruct 奖励可产生假阳性或假阴性；未发布校准集、评审间一致性、冻结输出或对抗评审审计。
0.9 的答案奖励权重使评审捷径主导二元格式信号，且无法识别哪个搜索或推理步骤失败。
动态采样从梯度更新中移除全对与全错组，改变有效提示分布，且无已发布的逐提示排除账本。
实时搜索与摘要器漂移可改变观察，因此即使回放同一问题，轨迹与评审结果均可改变。
格式有效性检查语法与工具调用 JSON，而非事实依据、来源质量、引用忠实性或无不必要动作。
Only search and visit are available; richer browser interaction and code execution are outside the reported environment.
Experiments center on short-answer information seeking; document-level synthesis and open-ended long-form reward modeling remain unresolved.
The authors report high rollout cost and limited RL data utilization, with only a small subset of the collected QA pool usable in RL.
Long-CoT transfer raises invalid/repetition rates, especially for smaller instruction models.
The live web is non-stationary; the paper attributes performance fluctuation partly to environment changes.
Tool hallucination and over-action can occur, including calls to nonexistent tools or redundant actions after the answer is known.
The public artifacts are samples rather than the complete corpus, so reported filtering, counts, and RL membership cannot be independently audited record by record.
仅 search 与 visit 可用；更丰富的浏览器交互与代码执行在所报告环境之外。
实验聚焦简答信息寻求；文档级综合与开放式长文奖励建模仍未解决。
作者报告高 rollout 成本与有限 RL 数据利用，所收集 QA 池中仅小子集可用于 RL。
Long-CoT 迁移提高无效/重复率，尤其对较小指令模型。
实时网页是非平稳的；论文将性能波动部分归因于环境变化。
可发生工具幻觉与过度动作，包括调用不存在的工具或在答案已知后的冗余动作。
公开产物是样本而非完整语料，因此所报告的过滤、计数与 RL 归属无法逐记录独立审计。
